   - H2PO4- (acidic)

   - CrO4-2 (yellow)

   - Cr2O7-2 (orange)

3. Anions that would give basic pH (pH ~12) with Cs+:
   - OH- (hydroxide) - very basic
   - CO3-2 (carbonate) - basic
   - PO4-3 (phosphate) - basic
   - S-2 (sulfide) - basic
   - F- (fluoride) - weakly basic, but could contribute

4. Solubility considerations with Cs+:
   - All cesium salts are highly soluble in water, so solubility doesn't help narrow down

Given pH = 12 (very basic) and colorless:
- OH- would give pH ~14 for typical concentrations
- CO3-2 would give pH ~11-12
- PO4-3 would give pH ~12-13
